name: Warm Spiced Mulled Apple Cider with Cinnamon & Clove
whyItWorks: Pure apple cider heated gently with cinnamon sticks and whole cloves (strained before serving). Soothing, hydrating, and seed-free winter warmer.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sip warm strained cider; ensure orange peel citrus slices are kept minimal.
watchOuts: High natural apple fructose; drink slowly if sensitive to fruit sugars
